data.one_liner: A CLI tool for optimizing test execution and manipulating code coverage trace files.
data.what_it_does: It gathers Dart test files into a single optimized entry point to speed up execution, validates coverage percentages, transforms and filters trace files, and generates HTML reports.
use_when: You want to optimize test execution times in CI/CD pipelines by gathering tests.
You need to validate coverage thresholds or transform lcov trace files.
You want to generate HTML coverage reports from trace files.
avoid_when: You are looking for a state management or UI component library.
You prefer writing custom shell scripts for coverage manipulation.
strengths: Accelerates test execution by reducing Dart VM spawn overhead.
Supports test sharding for parallel execution.
Provides comprehensive trace file transformation and validation features.
weaknesses: Requires global installation via pub and system PATH configuration.
The filter command is deprecated in favor of transform.
data.setup_notes: Activate globally using dart pub global activate coverde and add the system cache bin directory to your PATH.
data.minimal_example:
dart pub global activate coverde
coverde optimize-tests
